ArchitectureNotes.objective: Bidirectional real-time voice translation with minimal latency and reliable fallback chain.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Cloud deployment, multi-user support, browser-based STT.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Deepgram WS instability (error 10054) causes STT gaps. Mitigated by Whisper fallback.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: WASAPI COM references from device enumeration can block pipeline audio capture.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: Echo feedback through CABLE if meeting app misconfigured (speaker must be CABLE Input).
ArchitectureNotes.risk-4: Current Yandex STT and Whisper fallback paths are batch-oriented and cannot reliably meet sub-second response targets.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-5: Serial translation fallback amplifies tail latency when Groq or LiteLLM are slow or unreachable from Russia.
ArchitectureNotes.strategy-1: Introduce a low-latency realtime profile that reduces STT finalization delays and removes long retry pauses from the hot path.
ArchitectureNotes.strategy-2: Adopt a local-first critical path for ru/en using persistent local STT and local machine translation, while keeping cloud providers as optional fallback or quality lanes.
ArchitectureNotes.strategy-3: Move from final-utterance processing toward stable-partial and incremental playback to approach sub-second perceived latency.

DF-OUTGOING.NAME: Outgoing Pipeline (RU→EN)
DF-OUTGOING.step-1: Capture audio from Jabra mic via WASAPI (cpal)
DF-OUTGOING.step-2: Resample to 16kHz, send to Deepgram WebSocket Deepgram returns STT transcript (or Whisper fallback) Translate via Groq/LiteLLM/Yandex Synthesize English TTS via Piper Play through CABLE Input → meeting app → conference pipeline_trace.log: [outgoing] STT/TRANSLATE/PLAYBACK/METRICS events

DF-INCOMING.NAME: Incoming Pipeline (EN→RU)
DF-INCOMING.step-1: Capture audio from CABLE Output (remote audio from meeting app)
DF-INCOMING.step-2: Resample to 16kHz, send to Deepgram WebSocket (or Whisper) STT transcript returned Translate English → Russian via Groq/LiteLLM/Yandex Synthesize Russian TTS via Piper Play through Jabra speakers pipeline_trace.log: [incoming] STT/TRANSLATE/PLAYBACK/METRICS events

DF-CONFIG.NAME: Configuration Flow
DF-CONFIG.TRIGGER: User saves settings in Flask UI
DF-CONFIG.step-1: User edits settings in Flask web UI (http://127.0.0.1:5050)
DF-CONFIG.step-3: Elixir reads settings, passes as env vars to Rust engine
DF-CONFIG.step-4: Engine restarts pipelines with new config
DF-CONFIG.evidence: settings.json changes, engine restart in elixir_console.log

DF-FALLBACK.NAME: STT Fallback Chain
DF-FALLBACK.step-2: After 3 disconnections, switch to Yandex SpeechKit
DF-FALLBACK.step-3: If Yandex unavailable, switch to local Whisper (small model)
DF-FALLBACK.evidence: pipeline_trace.log: Switching to Yandex/Whisper STT messages

Wave.NAME: FastLatencyRelief
Wave.goal: Reduce avoidable latency in the current cloud-centric pipeline without changing the visible product flow.

changes.change-1: Lower Deepgram realtime endpointing and utterance finalization delay for short phrases.
changes.change-2: Replace serial translation fallback with fastest-success behavior in realtime mode.
changes.change-3: Remove long retry backoff and per-request HTTP client setup from the translation hot path.
changes.change-4: Add stage-level latency metrics and provider markers needed for before/after comparison.

Wave.NAME: LocalFirstCriticalPath
Wave.goal: Move the ru/en critical path off unstable external providers while preserving the current dual-pipeline behavior.

changes.change-1: Replace per-request Whisper fallback with a persistent local STT worker.
changes.change-2: Integrate the existing CTranslate2 wrapper as a first-class local translation provider.
changes.change-3: Separate the fast audio path from optional cloud-based correction or quality paths.
changes.change-4: Add a local-first Russia-oriented preset in runtime configuration and UI.

Wave.NAME: IncrementalStreamingArchitecture
Wave.goal: Reach sub-second perceived latency by overlapping STT, translation, TTS, and playback on stable partials.

changes.change-1: Emit partial and stable-partial transcript events from the STT layer.
changes.change-2: Add text-segment stabilization and stale-job cancellation in the engine.
changes.change-3: Support early playback from confirmed translated segments instead of waiting for full utterance completion.
